primary_sources.supports: Core chemical-engineering fundamentals; quantitative/scientific preparation; scientific creativity and formulation of questions; leadership/teamwork; scientific communication; PhD/MSCEP do not accept GRE.
Three references; recommenders who know applicant well; concrete examples of intellectual independence, analytical thinking, clear expression and achievement.
MSE masters application CV may include relevant research, publications, presentations and posters; three letters and SOP.
SOP addresses preparation, research interests, career aims and program fit; community statement can explain demonstrated values/contributions.

planning_priorities.title: 保护核心课程与自学
planning_priorities.action: 以4.5为成绩目标，同时能解释热力学、输运、动力学、电化学与表征基础。考试期不扩张无必要承诺。

planning_priorities.title: 把主导电池课题转为可核查证据
planning_priorities.action: 整理问题、你提出的判断、关键对照/重复、关键表征、被推翻假设与下一步；保留未知项。主课题独立所有权已确认，不反复质疑。

planning_priorities.title: 三封互补且具体的推荐
planning_priorities.action: 近期PI写独立科研，长期化工导师写成长与决策，第三位选最熟悉高阶课程/直接科研的人。强推承诺不等于已获接收反馈。

planning_priorities.title: 整合领导与交流证据
planning_priorities.action: 国创赛记录负责人协调企业/顾问/技术支持的真实决策和交付；网评未出不记获奖。报告、海报和组会侧重清晰说明研究及负结果。

planning_priorities.title: 低频维护申请素材
planning_priorities.action: 每月更新CV、研究摘要、5页研究展示、作者贡献与论文状态表。已接受、审稿、准备中分开，预计一区不算已发表。青年编委与秘书长按实际职责和工作记录。

critical_engine_risks: Only ETH M051 Process Engineering has an applicable official4.3/5 threshold; other ETH rows mention4.3 to say it must not be transferred.
MIT M0023.9 is an application-fee-waiver criterion, not an admissions minimum.
Do not identify a research route by text.includes(thesis/论文) because records can say replaces/no thesis.
UBC M106 MASc official4.0 applies; M107 MEng same central figure has unconfirmed program applicability.
Toronto honours category is not a verified NUS numeric threshold; letters/gpa planning targets are never hard gates.
NST/NUS S/U prevents assuming all160 programme units enter cumulative GPA calculations.
Strong recommendation or contacts do not remove prerequisite, English, thesis-supervisor or RPL constraints.
Conditional short durations and policy dates remain visible when background changes.
No numeric admission probabilities; qualitative scenario model must identify uncertainty and adjustable advisory assumptions.
